findings.message: Remove stale prelink copies before swapping publish items. If a legacy library is rebuilt or upgraded so it no longer needs designer rewriting, `ProcessAssemblyDesigner` returns false and leaves its previous prelink copy untouched. This existence-only check then replaces the current library with that obsolete copy, silently publishing old code. Track the current rewritten assemblies in a persisted manifest or remove obsolete copies when rerunning the task, rather than treating every existing file as valid.
